licenseKey.description: West Coast Charts Premium licence key. Needed only for premium chart types (sankey, chord, radialColumn, ...). Free types work without it.

defaultTheme.description: Theme used when a spec sets no theme.mode.

maxPixels.description: Upper bound for width*height*scale^2 of one render (protects shared servers).

evaluation.description: Without a licence key, render premium types with an "unlicensed" watermark (opt-in preview) instead of failing with kind "license".
